response.sql: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), group_shares AS (SELECT member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM group_counts), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM group_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gs.member_count), 0) AS total_members, AVG(gs.share) AS average_share, AVG(gs.share - b.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM group_shares AS gs CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE gs.share > b.average_share;
